crossRefs.note: Was Yahweh displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode…
Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

translations.web: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.
translations.bsb: You trampled the sea with Your horses, churning the great waters.
translations.kjv: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.
translations.asv: Thou didst tread the sea with thy horses, The heap of mighty waters.
